implemented_components.boundary: The engine implements SpawnConfirmations with an optional required ConfirmationExecutor. No production executor, successful synthetic child launch, actual board write, HTTP route/task-permit handoff or native acceptance is supplied or claimed. Tests use owned synthetic roots and explicit fake preparation failures/refusal callbacks. ConfirmationExecutor must be composed with real preparation/registration before the capability is available.
implemented_components.remaining_http_error_contract: Current shared SessionError carries explicit InvalidRequest messages for missing/already-decided confirmation; source404/409 mapping must be specified before the real HTTP caller is accepted.
implemented_components.shutdown_owner_contract: Stop admitting operations, drain accepted HTTP handoffs while the Hub task owner stays accepting, invoke shutdown_confirmations for pending cells, then cancel/drain committed tasks. An aborted task reports incomplete asynchronous cleanup rather than restoring an accepted decision.
